title: Yellow welcome panel
slide_intent: Use a color cue at a moment of arrival because people need to locate entrances and understand where to go.
strategic_value: A yellow welcome panel can make Lufthansa’s accent color useful as well as recognizable.
demonstration: A uniformed crew member stands in an open aircraft door beside a yellow crane-and-welcome panel.
practical_value: Evaluate whether an accent marks a useful passenger action or threshold.

content_islands.name: Entry and staff
content_islands.spec: Center the open doorway and crew member.

content_islands.name: Yellow signal
content_islands.spec: Place the small yellow welcome panel on the fuselage beside the entrance.

reference_purposes.Expression: A uniformed crew member stands in an open aircraft door beside a yellow crane-and-welcome panel.
reference_purposes.Intent: Mona Franz explicitly assigns orientation and identification roles to the revised yellow.

ingredient.name: Yellow welcome panel
ingredient.role: Identify the aircraft entrance and welcome the arriving passenger.
ingredient.application: Evaluate whether an accent marks a useful passenger action or threshold.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2018 Lufthansa airline refresh case study; observed example, not a complete brand manual or a current Lufthansa Group rule.
